zh-CN.failed: 启动未完成，请处理提示中的配置文件后重新打开 Jeemi。
zh-CN.title: Jeemi 配置文件错误
zh-CN.invalid:
以下配置文件的内容、字段或版本不符合要求：
{{file}}
zh-CN.invalidOffset:
以下配置文件无法解析（字节位置 {{offset}}）：
{{file}}
zh-CN.confirmMessage:
此文件无法修复为当前结构。是否删除此文件并继续启动？该文件中保存的设置或资源将丢失，关联配置可能需要重新设置。若是订阅记录，此订阅将从列表移除，需要重新添加；缓存原文不会删除。

选择“是”：仅删除上述文件并重新检查。
选择“否”或关闭对话框：保留文件并退出，供你自行修复。
zh-CN.repairMessage:
可以将此订阅记录修复为当前结构。修复会保留订阅来源、缓存原文和有效设置，移除不支持的字段，并恢复不兼容选项的默认值。原文件会备份在同一目录。

选择“是”：修复上述文件并继续启动，之后可在订阅页重新拉取。
选择“否”或关闭对话框：保留文件并退出。
zh-CN.otherError: 客户端初始化失败。请检查数据目录是否可访问，以及程序文件是否完整，然后重新启动。

en-US.failed: Startup did not complete. Fix the configuration file shown in the dialog and reopen Jeemi.
en-US.title: Jeemi configuration file error
en-US.invalid:
This configuration file has invalid contents, fields, or a version that is not supported:
{{file}}
en-US.invalidOffset:
This configuration file could not be parsed (byte offset {{offset}}):
{{file}}
en-US.confirmMessage:
This file cannot be repaired to the current format. Delete it and continue startup? Settings or resources stored in this file will be lost, and linked configurations may need to be adjusted. For a subscription record, the subscription will be removed from the list and must be added again; its cached source files will be kept.

Yes: delete only the file above and check again.
No or close this dialog: keep the file and exit so you can repair it manually.
en-US.repairMessage:
This subscription record can be repaired to the current format. Repair keeps its source, cached files and valid settings, removes unsupported fields, and resets incompatible options to their defaults. The original file will be backed up in the same folder.

Yes: repair this file and continue startup. You can refresh it later on the Subscriptions page.
No or close this dialog: keep the file and exit.
en-US.otherError: Client initialization failed. Check that the data directory is accessible and the application files are intact, then restart.
